_comment: Per-tenant standards definition — the customer's own 'what good looks like' inputs that make the definition-gated KPIs (SSU non-admin split, SCI, FCS, MCS) fully scorable. Copy to standards.<tenantId>.json, fill in with the customer, and the Effective Consumption analysis reads it. Nothing here is guessed by the tool; an unfilled file leaves those KPIs excluded from the OES denominator (the normal ⚪ treatment). Gen3-first: list platform-native surfaces (source tags, host groups, segments) — never management zones or classic-tag-mapping targets.

requiredTagKeys._comment: SCI/FCS foundation. Keys every host (and, where noted, service) should carry as SOURCE tags. SCI = mean over this set of (entities carrying the key / total entities); a key with zero coverage counts as 0, not omitted.

metadataPatterns._comment: MCS. Regex each shared field's VALUE must match. PatternCompliance = entities whose value matches / entities carrying the key. Anchor your regexes.

adminUserIds: _comment_replace_with_real_ids: user.id values (or resolve from the admin/owner IAM groups below) that count as ADMINS. SSU = non-admin configurators / all configurators. Leave empty to fall back to participation-rate SSU (configurators / eligible users).

targets._comment: Optional overrides for the normalization constants. Omit to use defaults. queryDiversityBucketTarget replaces the hard-coded 15 in QEI; selfServiceParticipationTarget replaces the 0.2 (20% of eligible) scale gate; noisePenaltyCap replaces 0.5; tokenShareTarget is the CCS config-as-code nirvana (0.7); includeCCS folds CCS into the Automation pillar (the 2026-07-14 composition upgrade — set false to reproduce the source model); outlierFenceMultiplier is the k in median + k*IQR actor fencing.

personaCounts._comment: EUB (expected-users baseline) overrides — the customer's own ratios beat the rough defaults in effective-consumption.md §9b. expectedUsers, when set, is an actual platform-team headcount from the customer and replaces the whole estimate (removes the estimate caveat). EUB is context for engagement, never an OES input.

oesWeights._comment: Resolve the source model's weight conflict explicitly. 'code' = Signals .35 / Automation .35 / Foundation .20 / Engagement .10 (default); 'prose' = .35 / .20 / .10 / .35. Or set custom values that sum to 1.0.
